step_5_and_6_familiar_places.short_description: Where we live — 2-storey ancestral home near Silpukhuri pond with green garden.
Where we shop — morning fresh fish and local vegetable stalls 300m away.
Place of worship — Community prayer hall for daily 5:30 PM Naam-Kirtan prayers.
Where I get checkups — neighborhood healthcare clinic on Nabagraha Road.
Where we walk — lakeside walking path where he meets fellow retired teachers.
